meta.schedule_basis: Classes sit where the stored schedule placed them. When the facts change without a reschedule, scripts/sync_facts.py re-stamps teacher, course and title onto the same day, slot and room and re-validates; nothing is moved.
meta.privacy: No personal data. CNIC and mobile numbers present in the source PDF are never carried into this file; teachers appear by name and role only.

juma_break.note: Friday 01:00-02:00pm is closed in every room for Juma prayer (data/Rooms.xlsx).

rules.meetings_per_course: Every course meets once a week (27 Sep): 2 hours if it carries lab hours, 1.5 hours if not, on a grid of half-hour units from 08:30am to 05:00pm. Lab hours are read from the credit-hour string: 3 (2-1) and 4 (3-1) carry a lab, 3 (3-0) and 2 (2-0) do not.
rules.graduate: Each MS course meets once a week at a day, time and room the department fixed: Dr. Wareesa Sharif Monday 12:00-02:00pm (any room); Prof. Dr. Najia Saher Wednesday in AIRA LAB (2.01), Dr. Malik Muhammad Saad Missen Thursday (any room) and Dr. Ghulam Gillani Friday in 2.06, each 02:00-04:00pm. MS courses sharing a title and teacher are combined into one class. Each PhD class meets in a room of its own off the room sheet: Prof. Dr. Najia Saher's Tuesday 02:00-04:00pm in 2.46, Dr. Wareesa Sharif's Wednesday in 2.50, Dr. Ghulam Gillani's Wednesday 02:00-04:00pm in 2.51.
rules.combined_sections: Some BS sections are taught together - one class, one teacher, one room. BSARIN-7TH-4E and BSADARIN-7TH-1M share every course they have in common; Mr. Shahzad Hanif teaches 4TH-1M+2M and 4TH-3M+4M together (Mr. Muzammil Ur Rehman's sections are taught apart again from 27 Sep). Each section still has its own sheet; a combined placement lists every section it serves.
rules.first_semester: First-semester BS sections are taught 08:30am to 04:00pm at the latest (never the 04:00pm slot), Monday to Friday, in departmental rooms only.
rules.regular_teachers_saturday: Regular teachers, departmental or not (teachers/teachers.json), are not scheduled on Saturday. Exception: Dr. Ghulam Gillani's MS and PhD classes. Since 1 Oct "Regular - Non Teaching" counts as Regular here, so those 14 teachers lose Saturday too; a Teaching Assistant is not Regular and keeps it.
rules.teacher_hours: Prof. Dr. Najia Saher, Dr. Ghulam Gillani, Mr. Muzammil Ur Rehman, Mr. Shahzad Rahim and Ms. Rabia Ejaz teach between 10:00am and 04:00pm, Dr. Wareesa Sharif and Dr. Waqas Mahmood between 10:00am and 02:00pm, Ms. Fizza Aslam and Ms. Marrium Aslam between 10:00am and 04:00pm Mon-Thu, two classes a day at most (Ms. Fizza Aslam on two days, 28 Sep), Ms. Sonia Jamil on Saturday only (28 Sep), and Dr. Shafqat Ali between 10:00am and 04:00pm Mon-Fri, waiting half an hour at most (27 Sep). Prof. Dr. Najia Saher's BS classes are on Thursday in 2.06, 12:00-02:00pm and 02:00-04:00pm.
rules.departmental_free_period: Regular - Departmental teachers (teachers/teachers.json) are kept free on Tuesday 01:00-02:30pm, except for Prof. Dr. Najia Saher's PhD class, which the department fixed at 02:00-04:00pm.
rules.teacher_one_building_per_day: A teacher who teaches in one building on a day teaches only in that building that day, as a section does (27 Sep).
rules.teacher_commitments: Mr. Muhammad Nauman and Mr. Zohaib Anwar assist Mr. Faisal Shahzad with his lectures in another department; none of their classes overlaps those lectures (data/teacher-commitments.json).
rules.frozen_slots: Mr. Shahzad Rahim, Ms. Rabia Ejaz and Ms. Sonia Jamil keep their day and start times as they were on 27 Sep (data/frozen.json) - Ms. Sonia Jamil's Friday class since moved to Saturday 11:00am (28 Sep); their rooms may change.
rules.one_building_per_day: A section that appears in one building on a day stays in that building for the whole day. The four buildings are the Department (2.06, 2.22-2.27), Mathematics (MATHS-*), the Chemistry Department Building (CHEM-1.04, CHEM-1.06) and the single-room CAPSID Lab.
rules.room_size: CAPSID LAB seats 40 students and CHEM-1.04 and CHEM-1.06 seat 50 each; a class goes in one only if all its students fit, counting every section of a combined class (data/reference/student_strength.csv).
rules.room_fragmentation: Rooms are packed class against class: a free stretch in a room-day too short for any class (under 1.5 hours) costs in the objective (verification.room_units_lost_to_fragmentation).
rules.four_day_groups: Every section attends inside one four-day group: group 1 is Mon-Thu, group 2 is Wed-Sat. They overlap on Wed and Thu, so capacity can flow between them.
rules.teachers: Every teacher keeps one day of the week free and waits at most three hours between two classes in a day; less is preferred.
rules.first_semester_rooms: First-semester sections are taught only in departmental rooms (2.06, 2.22-2.27).
rules.fyp: FYP-I and FYP-II are printed on the section sheet but occupy no slot.
rules.common_courses: Delivered online and consume no room. The whole day a section has an online lecture is kept free of campus classes for that section - not merely the overlapping hour - so nobody travels in around an online class. Two exceptions by department decision (24 Sep), each clear of the online hour: BSARIN-3RD-1M's ARIN-1120, shared with BSARIN-3RD-2M, on 3RD-1M's online days; and BSARIN-3RD-2E's ARIN-1108 (Ms. Sonia Jamil, then Fri/Sat only) on its Friday; later BSARIN-2ND-3M's ARIN-1106 on Monday (25 Sep) and BSARIN-1ST-2M's ARIN-1102 with Prof. Dr. Najia Saher on Thursday (27 Sep), which need not join up with that day's online class.
rules.course_identity: A course offering is keyed on (session, course_code). Several schemes of study run concurrently, so the same course may carry a different code or credit hours in a different session; that is an error only within one session.
rules.code_spelling: Internal spaces in a course code are significant and preserved (ARIN- 1110, ARIN- 4301, PS- 401).
rules.removed_courses: The MS/PhD Arabic courses (FIA-30294, FIA-30295) are removed by department decision of 23 Sep: no slot, no sheet entry, not awaiting a time. The allocation still lists them; data.removed_offerings records each one. BS Arabic (TSAQN-401) is unaffected.

verification.note_contiguity: Contiguity is measured over the open half hours of each day. Friday 01:00-02:00pm is closed everywhere for Juma, so a Friday spanning the break counts as contiguous, not gapped. A lonely trip is a section-day holding exactly one departmental class - a journey to campus for a single lecture; online common courses are not delivered on campus and so do not prevent one.

teacher_status.note: Employment status per teacher, recorded by the department in teachers/teachers.html. That file is the authority; re-run this script after editing it. An empty string means not yet recorded. "Regular - Non Teaching" is permanent staff in a non-teaching post who also take classes, and counts as Regular for the no-Saturday rule; "Teaching Assistant" is a PhD or MS student teaching under a faculty member, and does not.
teacher_status.ta_notes: A Teaching Assistant also carries ta_degree (the degree read for), ta_association (the faculty member assisted, expanded to the full name where the roster holds exactly one match) and ta_association_as_given (the department's own shorthand). Nobody else carries these fields.
